title: Compare five aminoglycoside biosynthetic gene clusters
summary: Start from five MIBiG gene clusters and the Web defaults, then fix what each preview shows: link the clusters with LOSATP similarity groups, reverse the cluster stored on the other strand, align the rows on a shared gene, color genes by antiSMASH gene_kind, label the first cluster, and finish the figure.
primaryWorkflow: LOSATP similarity groups with feature color rules
requirements: GenBank features that retain antiSMASH qualifiers such as gene_kind.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Linear. Linear mode draws each gene cluster as one row and can link the rows by protein similarity.

media.alt: Mode selector with Linear selected.
media.caption: Select Linear before adding inputs.

manualSteps.title: Add the first cluster
manualSteps.body: Under File 1, upload BGC0000708.gbk as the GenBank / DDBJ File. The file holds one record, so its name fields are on the File card: enter the organism in Organism / strain and the subtitle in Subtitle / title. Type the <i> tags literally: the SVG uses them to italicize the taxon name.

manualSteps.title: Link the clusters with LOSATP similarity groups
manualSteps.body: Under Comparison, click Run LOSAT and open Settings. Press LOSATP to compare the encoded proteins, and set LOSATP mode to Similarity groups: gbdraw groups similar proteins across all five clusters and links the group members in adjacent rows. Set Min identity (%) to 30 so that weak matches are not drawn. Click Generate Diagram; LOSAT runs in the browser and takes a few seconds for these clusters.
manualSteps.note: Similarity groups are visualization groups built from retained protein-search hits; they do not infer phylogeny-based orthology.

manualSteps.title: Align the rows on similarity group og_6
manualSteps.body: To line up the shared genes, align the rows on one similarity group. In the preview, click the neoU CDS of BGC0000709 (row 2), which belongs to og_6, and choose Review alignment options…. The Review alignment panel opens beside the figure: a Reference card for neoU, then one card per other record, grouped under sections such as Several candidates and One candidate. The figure rings the candidates and draws a reference line. BGC0000708 has two og_6 members: livU (CAG38700.1), the representative member with a reciprocal best hit, is preselected and marked Recommended; the transport protein CAG38692.1 near the left end of the cluster is the other candidate. Keep livU, leave Arrow direction at Keep as is, and click Apply. Apply regenerates the preview, so you do not click Generate Diagram.
manualSteps.note: Align… applies the same recommended anchors without the review. Choose Skip in a record card to leave that record where it is. Reset alignment… undoes an alignment; see the Web alignment reference for its scopes.

manualSteps.title: Color the genes by antiSMASH gene kind
manualSteps.body: Every CDS is still the same blue, so the figure does not show which genes are biosynthetic. These MIBiG records carry antiSMASH gene_kind qualifiers. Open Colors, choose the orange palette, and set the CDS default color to #dddddd for genes that no rule matches. The palette also turns the ribbons blue, so the red core genes stand out against them. Then add the four SPECIFIC RULES below, one row at a time, and click Generate Diagram.

operations.title: Four gene_kind rules
operations.note: Value patterns are regular expressions. biosynthetic$ matches only values that end in biosynthetic, so it does not also catch biosynthetic-additional.

media.caption: The four gene_kind rules in SPECIFIC RULES.

manualSteps.title: Finish the figure
manualSteps.body: Shape the arrows first: Shaft Width Ratio 0.6 narrows the shafts to 60% of the feature height so that the arrowheads stand out, and Head Length Ratio 0.64 shortens the heads so that more of the short genes keep a shaft. Turn off Separate Strands so each cluster reads as one row of arrows. The size rows fix the sizes of the published figure, which Auto would otherwise choose from the length of the longest cluster: Feature Height, the legend swatch, and the definition lines become slightly smaller than their Auto values, Label Font Size goes from 24 to 18, Line Stroke Width becomes thinner, and Block Stroke Width, Axis Stroke Width, the ruler label size, and the legend font size repeat their current Auto values. The two stroke colors darken the feature outlines and the axis. Add the ruler scale and the plot title, and click Generate Diagram. Generate keeps the og_6 alignment and reuses the LOSAT results.

manualSteps.title: Inspect a similarity-group ribbon
manualSteps.body: Click a pairwise match ribbon to inspect the gbdraw group ID, the gene count and record coverage, and the member table.
manualSteps.note: og_18 has six genes in five records: BGC0000713 contributes two, racL and racM, which together correspond to the NeoA-family protein that is one gene in the other clusters. The member table lists both.

media.alt: Selected og_18 pairwise ribbon beside its similarity-group popup.
media.caption: Click the og_18 ribbon; the popup shows og_18, 6 genes in 5 records, and the member table.

actions.script: async () => { document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1.4; const frame = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve), 300)); await frame(); for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) { const rect = document.querySelector('path[data-gbdraw-pairwise-match-id=\'comparison3_match1\']')?.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!rect) throw new Error('Pan target path[data-gbdraw-pairwise-match-id=\'comparison3_match1\'] was not found.'); const dx = 420 - rect.left; const dy = 380 - rect.top; if (Math.abs(dx) < 1 && Math.abs(dy) < 1) break; app.canvasPan.x += dx; app.canvasPan.y += dy; await frame(); } }

const popup = document.querySelector('.pairwise-match-popup'); const target = document.querySelector("path[data-gbdraw-pairwise-match-id='comparison3_match1']"); const text = popup?.textContent || ''; const rect = target?.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!text.includes('og_18') || !rect) throw new Error('Expected og_18 popup content was not restored.'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (app?.clickedPairwiseMatchPos) { app.clickedPairwiseMatchPos.x = Math.round(rect.right + 24); app.clickedPairwiseMatchPos.y = 206; }

() => { const target = document.querySelector("path[data-gbdraw-pairwise-match-id='comparison3_match1']")?.getBoundingClientRect(); const popup = document.querySelector('.pairwise-match-popup')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return Boolean(target && popup && (popup.right <= target.left || popup.left >= target.right || popup.bottom <= target.top || popup.top >= target.bottom)); }

const popup = document.querySelector('.pairwise-match-popup'); const header = popup?.children[0]; const rows = Array.from(popup?.querySelectorAll('tbody tr') || []); const firstMember = rows[0]?.querySelector('td'); const lastMember = rows[rows.length - 1]?.querySelector('td'); if (!popup || !header || rows.length !== 6 || !String(firstMember?.textContent || '').includes('BGC0000708')) throw new Error('Compact og_18 member table not found.'); header.setAttribute('data-capture', 'og18-popup-header'); lastMember.setAttribute('data-capture', 'og18-last-member');

colorRules.title: Use gene_kind for antiSMASH categories
colorRules.body: These BGC records carry antiSMASH gene_kind qualifiers for core biosynthetic, additional biosynthetic, transport, and regulatory categories. Use those annotations instead of matching broad product terms.

colorRules.title: Use gene for label text
colorRules.body: Set the CDS qualifier priority to gene so rotated labels use concise gene names when available.

colorRules.title: Keep regex values specific
colorRules.body: Specific rule values are matching patterns. Use biosynthetic$ for core biosynthetic genes and a separate biosynthetic-additional rule for the additional category.

colorRules.title: Use product only as a fallback
colorRules.body: When gene_kind is absent, product can group functional categories, but terms such as protein, enzyme, or transporter may match more features than intended.

colorRules.title: Use descriptive legend names
colorRules.body: Use names such as Core biosynthetic genes and Transport-related genes instead of raw qualifier values.

losatTips.title: Start with Auto execution
losatTips.body: Auto uses threaded LOSAT only when the browser supports it and the workload justifies it.

losatTips.title: Prefer Safe total threads
losatTips.body: Safe leaves some logical CPUs unused so the browser can remain responsive.

losatTips.title: Use similarity groups for protein-level BGC comparison
losatTips.body: Similarity groups uses retained protein-search hits to form visualization groups even when local gene order differs across clusters. It does not perform phylogeny-based orthology inference.

losatTips.title: Tune the match thresholds together
losatTips.body: Raise the identity, bit score, or minimum-length threshold, or lower the E-value cutoff, when the figure has too many weak ribbons. Relax those thresholds when expected protein matches are missing.

losatTips.title: Reuse the cache
losatTips.body: The app reuses LOSAT results when the input files and LOSAT settings have not changed, so label, color, and legend edits avoid another search.

troubleshooting.title: The rows do not line up like the Gallery figure
troubleshooting.body: Check the input order, Reverse complement on BGC0000713 (File 5), and the alignment on gbdraw group og_6: neoU of BGC0000709 is the reference, and BGC0000708 keeps livU (CAG38700.1), not the transport protein CAG38692.1.

troubleshooting.title: Core genes are not red
troubleshooting.body: Check that the input GenBank files include gene_kind qualifiers and that the core rule uses biosynthetic$.

troubleshooting.title: Labels are missing or too dense
troubleshooting.body: Use Show labels: first record, label placement above feature, and 45° label rotation. If needed, reduce labels by tightening the label filter.

troubleshooting.title: Threaded LOSAT is unavailable
troubleshooting.body: Use Auto or Serial execution. Some browser contexts disable SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation, which prevents threaded WebAssembly.

troubleshooting.title: The generated diagram differs from the Gallery image
troubleshooting.body: Compare your settings with the Full settings table in step 10: LOSATP mode, Min identity (%), record orientation, alignment, color rules, labels, Separate Strands, and the finishing values.
